rationale: No profile is returned, which alone would mean request_information. The open KYC-mismatch alert is itself a sourced concern that needs only the alert record, so it is reported, and a concern outranks missing information (ADR 018): escalate. No sanctions search is made without a legal name.

context.description: Open KYC discrepancy for a customer without a KYC profile. Entirely fictional evaluation case.

expected.summary: An open KYC alert is reported even when the profile itself is missing.

signals.statement: An open alert reports inconsistent KYC information.
